es: Corregirte a ti mismo y explicar con rodeos una palabra que no recuerdas (or rather, let me rephrase, the tool you use for…, for lack of a better word) sin perder el hilo ni la credibilidad.

prompt.es: Completa: «La auditoría empieza el lunes, o mejor dicho, el martes.»

feedback.es: Or rather corrige con precisión lo que acabas de decir, sin detener la conversación.

hint.es: Es la palabra que, tras or, introduce una corrección más exacta.

origin.text: The director reads the schedule aloud: “The audit starts on Monday, or ___, on Tuesday, because Monday is a public holiday.”

prompt.es: Ordena: «Déjame reformularlo: necesitamos más tiempo para revisar el archivo.»

answer.text: Let me rephrase that: we need more time to check the archive

feedback.es: Let me rephrase that introduce una nueva versión de lo dicho, que aquí es más precisa.

hint.es: Empieza con la fórmula de reformular; después van los dos puntos y la nueva frase.

prompt.es: ¿Qué descripción explica mejor la palabra «stapler» sin decirla?

choices.text: It is the tool you use to write on a board.
It is the tool you use to hold papers together.
It is the tool you use to cut paper into pieces.

feedback.es: Una circunlocución describe la función: la grapadora sujeta papeles; las otras dos describen un marcador y unas tijeras.

hint.es: Describe para qué sirve el objeto: sujetar hojas.

origin.text: You need a stapler but you cannot remember the word, and the office is noisy. You decide to describe the object instead of stopping to search for the word.

prompt.es: Completa: «déjame reformularlo» y «quería decir la carpeta verde».

feedback.es: Let me rephrase that introduce otra versión y I meant rectifica un dato concreto.

sentences: Sorry, that came out wrongly; let me ___ that in simpler words.
I asked for the blue folder; sorry, I ___ the green one.

prompt.es: Escucha la escena y elige qué estrategia usa Daniel y qué consigue.

choices.text: He changes the subject so that nobody notices the gap.
He apologises at length and then asks for a short break.
He describes the job until someone helps, and keeps his pace.

feedback.es: Describe el trabajo («someone who fixes leaking pipes») hasta que un colega da la palabra, y así mantiene el ritmo de la presentación.

origin.audio: In the middle of his presentation, Daniel lost the word for plumber. Instead of stopping, he said that he needed someone who fixes leaking pipes, for lack of a better word, a water doctor. The audience laughed, a colleague supplied the right word, and he carried on without missing a beat.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase corrige bien lo que acabas de decir?

choices.text: We meet at five, or rather, at six.
We meet at five, or better said, at six.
We meet at five, and meanwhile, at six.

feedback.es: Or rather es la forma natural de corregirse; «or better said» es un calco del español y la tercera no corrige nada.

origin.text: You have told a colleague the wrong time for tomorrow's meeting, and you realise your mistake a second later. You want to correct yourself smoothly.

prompt.es: Describe con rodeos una palabra: el lugar donde la empresa guarda contratos antiguos.

answer.text: It is the place where the company keeps its old contracts.
accepted: It is the place where the company keeps its old contracts.
It is the room where they store the old contracts.
It's where the company keeps all its old contracts.
It is the place where old contracts are stored.
It is the department where the firm files its past contracts.

feedback.es: La circunlocución usa the place where… y describe la función, sin decir archive.

origin.text: No recuerdas la palabra «archive». Descríbela con rodeos en una frase: es el lugar donde la empresa conserva sus contratos antiguos.

evidenceGroups: where all the old contracts are

prompt.es: Escucha la reunión y elige cuándo estará listo el borrador.

choices.text: On Friday, as first announced, with the final version a week later.
On Thursday, together with the final version.
On Thursday, with the final version following a week later.
The following week, as soon as the director is back.

feedback.es: Con «or rather» cambia Friday por Thursday y al reformular añade que la versión final llegará una semana después del borrador.

origin.audio: At the end of the quarterly meeting, the finance manager summed up. The draft, she said, would be ready on Friday; or rather, on Thursday, because the director would be away on Friday. She then paused and rephrased: what she meant was that the draft would be ready on Thursday, and the final version a week later. Someone asked about the new head of sales, and she could not recall his title. The word escapes me, she admitted; he is, so to speak, our new head of everything. Everybody laughed, and a colleague supplied the word.

prompt.es: Escucha de nuevo: ¿qué impresión deja su manera de corregirse?

choices.text: That she is poorly prepared and should have checked her notes.
That she prefers to avoid any question about the contracts.
That she repeats herself because the audience is not listening.
That she stays in control and repairs errors without losing credibility.

feedback.es: Se corrige dos veces y pide ayuda con naturalidad: la reunión sigue sin problemas, lo que sugiere control y no improvisación descuidada.

origin.audio: At the end of the quarterly meeting, the finance manager summed up. The draft, she said, would be ready on Friday; or rather, on Thursday, because the director would be away on Friday. Someone asked about the new head of sales, and she could not recall his title. The word escapes me, she admitted; he is, so to speak, our new head of everything. Everybody laughed, and a colleague supplied the word.

prompt.es: Completa: «A falta de una palabra mejor, es una especie de cuchillo doble.»

feedback.es: For lack of a better word avisa de que tu descripción es aproximada.

origin.text: I cannot remember the word, but for lack of a better ___, it is a kind of double knife for cutting paper.

prompt.es: ¿Qué valoración hace el comité de esta candidata?

choices.text: That her quick repairs showed control rather than weakness.
That her repairs were so many that they became annoying.
That she should have avoided every correction she made.
That she lost the thread each time she corrected herself.

feedback.es: El comité anota que cada corrección fue rápida y que nunca perdió el hilo: la ve como señal de control y no de debilidad.

origin.text: The candidate corrected herself three times in a single minute: or rather, sorry, I meant, and let me rephrase. The panel noted that each repair was quick, that her tone stayed calm and that she never lost the thread of her answer. One member said it made her sound more natural, not less prepared.

answer.text: We have dinner on Thursday, or rather, on Friday night

feedback.es: Or rather introduce la corrección: Thursday pasa a Friday night.
